channel.title: Lesotho - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Lesotho, every source cited.

item.title: Lesotho Correctional Service promotions challenged in court
item.description: Assistant Superintendent Moji Zakea questions the January promotion of five officers to Senior Superintendent.

item.title: Heirs fight over M450,000 Leribe property
item.description: Deceased businessman's family claims ownership of commercial plots sold in 2000.

item.title: Lesotho police risk allowance dispute continues
item.description: Officers are seeking an increase from M100 to M1500 monthly, a proposal facing bureaucratic delays.

item.title: Standard Bank plants 2000 trees in Mafeteng
item.description: The bank partnered with the Ministry of Environment and Forestry to boost conservation and biodiversity in Ha-Khojane.

item.title: WASCO begins Mafeteng drought relief plan
item.description: The water utility will dredge Rasebale Dam and drill boreholes to secure district water supplies.
